contracts.title: Gate bypass
contracts.description: A later artefact or implementation was produced without the required exact approval.

contracts.title: QA without task-plan review
contracts.description: QA is evaluated for Structured Delivery without prior task-plan coverage evidence.

contracts.title: Parallel source of truth
contracts.description: A second source of truth was introduced for product intent, runtime behavior, visible state, policy or persistent domain data.

contracts.title: Documentation or SoT impact unchecked
contracts.description: A behavior, architecture, API, UX, policy or runtime change was completed without checking the affected source-of-truth artefacts.

contracts.title: Test scope unclear
contracts.description: Tests were cited but are not traceable to affected acceptance criteria, tasks or risk paths.

contracts.title: Quick task evidence light
contracts.description: A Quick Task has minimal evidence that may be acceptable for scope and risk but must remain visible.

contracts.title: Ambiguous active scope
contracts.description: Multiple active work lines are plausible and the agent must not choose one silently.

contracts.title: Branch or workspace is not scope proof
contracts.description: Branch names and workspace deltas may support a scope only when they do not conflict with durable artefacts or approvals.

contracts.title: Knowledge persistence decision missing
contracts.description: A relevant run ended without deciding whether new durable knowledge belongs in the Context Graph, SoT registry, scope artefact, open questions or nowhere.

contracts.title: Bug Lightweight Track lacks bug evidence
contracts.description: A lightweight defect path requires durable reproduction, actual behavior, expected behavior, fix boundary, open questions and evidence plan.
